messages:
sam: Heads-up — p99 on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate spiked yesterday evening but p50 stayed flat. anyone else seeing route-level tails?

 talia: yup. p95 shifted a bit too, p50 unchanged. raw histo shows a tiny slice of requests >1200ms from eu-west. :thinking:

 liam: could be sampling or a weird client cohort. did any rollout change sampling headers or rates?

 deploy-bot: Canary rollout to eu-west completed by @sam at 2024-11-07T19:03Z :white_check_mark:

 jun: what query does the dashboard use — are we looking at tdigest rollups or sampled aggregates? sampled data would explain a lopsided p99.

 sam: panel uses telem_v2 rollups + quantiles aggregation. snippet:
```sql
SELECT route, quantiles(0.5,0.95,0.99)(latency_ms) as (p50,p95,p99)
FROM telem_v2.rollups
WHERE org = 'redwood' AND region = 'eu-west'
GROUP BY route
```

 talia: we enabled an internal debug header last week for the canary and set that cohort to 100% sampling. if slow requests set X-Internal-Debug, that cohort is over-represented in rollups.

 liam: ohhhhh. so a small cohort with 100% sample + lots of retries/large payloads -> tail amplification. can you confirm by filtering out that header?

 sam: quick check: filtering out X-Internal-Debug drops p99 from 1234ms -> 210ms for /v1/generate. raw numbers: p99_before=1234, p99_after=210.

 jun: that matches cohort bias. two options: (1) stop sampling that header into global rollups, or (2) surface cohort/sample metadata on the dashboard so folks know percentiles include special cohorts.

 ops-bot: created ticket INF-8421: "Remove debug-cohort from global rollups" assigned to eng-platform.

 talia: UX ask: console should display a small badge on percentile widgets when the underlying rollup has non-default sample cohorts or header tags (e.g., "includes debug cohort"). makes the skew obvious to oncall.

 liam: also propose adding a dropdown filter on endpoint breakdown: sample_source and sample_rate, defaulting to 'all' but easily toggled to compare 'exclude debug cohort'.

 sam: i'll add a short regression test to the aggregation pipeline to detect >x% shift in p99 when excluding single-tag cohorts — fail CI if tests flip by >50% without a comment.

 jun: for the short term we should amend the dashboard query to compute weighted p99 using sample weights, or explicitly exclude the header in the rollup join. tdigest supports weighted inserts but our rollup path currently treats each row equally.

 liam: summary action items: 1) INF-8421 to change rollup config (jun) 2) console badge + dropdown (talia) 3) aggregation regression test + patch (sam) 4) doc note on sampling semantics in dashboard help (liam).

 talia: i'll open a console PR with mockups for the badge + filter today. tagging @console-team. :memo:

 sam: thanks — feel better knowing it's a cohort skew not a query bug. will monitor the ticket. :thumbsup:

 liam: awesome catch. :eyes:

 jun: leaving the ops checklist in INF-8421 with rollback steps and a temp dashboard that shows p50/p95/p99 side-by-side with cohort excluded.

 talia: FYI we should also surface sample metadata in the route-level API response for the console so the UI can explain sudden p99 jumps without manual triage.

 sam: agreed. follow-ups in the ticket.

 deploy-bot: NOTE: canary flagged by infra health probe at 2024-11-07T20:10Z — autoscaled canary reverted to previous version :information_source:
